features.title: Built to survive an audit, not just a glance.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Do I need to install anything in the car?
faq.a1: No. Drivers and instructors use the CMFleet app on their phone. GPS and odometer photos come from the phone.
faq.a2: From the driver's phone: start, stop, route and miles by GPS, with an odometer photo per car at the start and end of the month. Nobody types the miles in.
faq.a3: Each active vehicle in your fleet. Every plan includes some cars in its monthly price and charges each extra car; archived vehicles are not billed, and the next invoice follows your current count.
faq.a4: A location of your business. Starter includes 1 and Growth 2; you can add a few more for a monthly fee, and Enterprise includes unlimited branches.
faq.q5: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.a5: Yes. Plans are billed monthly through Stripe and you manage them from Settings > Billing.
faq.q6: What is the one-time service acquisition?
faq.a6: A single payment for the right to use the professional software of the service you choose. It depends on your plan and is the same for every service. You pay it together with your first month after the free trial.
